article.en: Mr James Scott has a garage in Silbury.
article.zh: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在锡尔伯里有一个汽车修理部。

article.en: Now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.

article.en: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury.

article.en: Mr Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage, so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
article.zh: 斯科特先生未能为他的新汽车修理部搞到一部电话机，所以他刚刚买了十二只鸽子。

article.en: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
article.zh: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特带到锡尔伯里。

article.en: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.

article.en: Up to now, Mr Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
article.zh: 到目前为止，斯科特先生已经从一个汽车修理部向另一个发送了大量索取备件的信件和其他紧急函件。

article.en: In this way, he has begun his own private telephone service.
